child.text:
[{"insert":"DB Front Rack Split Squat

The DB front rack split squat holds the dumbbells up at your shoulders, which forces your core and upper back to work harder to stay tall than a goblet or suitcase hold would. The split stance loads one leg at a time, so keep your front heel flat and drive through it on every rep. Reps climb to twelve per side this week, so pick a load you can own for the full set. Finish with the hamstring walkout to balance out the back of your legs.
"}]
